items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: But anyway, so Jimmy had heard Spider play and he knew he wanted that sound.

ctx.x: Of Las Vegas. But anyway, so Jimmy had heard Spider play and he knew he wanted that sound. So he hired a guy from a local high school, a big barrel-chested PE teacher, and he assigned him to Spider Ridgeway. He said, “If he touches a drink kick his ass.” I mean this guy stayed with him. And Spider would tell us, “Oh man I’d love to have a drink but this bastard won’t —.” That’s the way he talked. And he had a spotless tour. Man he kicked that band all during the thing. We played and we ended up playing in Atlanta…
You said, when you weren’t sure who this was you said, “Well he’s got some of my licks.” So what are your licks? How do you recognize.
